public.title: Styled Text Ranges
public.description: input {text,ranges,start,end}; text is ASCII, ranges are sorted disjoint [start,end,style] triples with nonempty string styles and half-open bounds. Return {text,ranges} for slicing text to [start,end), clipping styles to that span and subtracting start from surviving endpoints. Omit empty styles; preserve range order. Text length at most 100, 0 no greater than start no greater than end no greater than text length. Supported inputs are valid for this contract. Aggregate JSON-serialized input is at most 512 UTF-8 bytes, nesting depth at most 6, arrays at most 40 items, operation/call lists at most 20 items, and individual strings at most 100 ASCII characters unless a tighter bound is stated. Integers have absolute value at most 1000; output arithmetic stays within safe integers. String object keys and string path segments are nonempty safe alphanumeric/underscore names excluding __proto__, constructor and prototype. Empty arrays/objects are allowed where consistent with the contract. Output ordering follows the rules above. These bounds include all nested payloads and all operations together.
hints: Separate the documented JSON representation from the behavior being modeled.
Preserve ordering and distinguish missing values, null, zero and false carefully.

explanation: Intersect each styled interval with the selected span, discard empty intersections and translate endpoints. O(text slice length plus range count) time and output space. Functional tests check the documented adapter behavior; they do not enforce implementation technique or prohibit built-in APIs.
